description: This file declares functions and constants related to hibernation processes, including 'HibernateProcess' and 'WakeupProcess', and defines error codes for hibernation operations.

methods.name: HibernateProcess
methods.description: Initiates a hibernation process with specified timeout, process ID, data directories, and storage pointer.

methods.name: WakeupProcess
methods.description: Wakes up a process from hibernation with specified timeout, process ID, data directories, and storage pointer.
